decision_cruda.rationale: E569-01 is stopped for 5-8 h, so LH-03 is idle. I put it on RS-E595-01 (9.8 g/t, 293 t, 0.5 h activation). It should load about 150 t, or about 47 oz, by 17:00. RS-E595-03 is bigger but only 6.2 g/t, which gives roughly 28 oz. Este has haulage room (inflow 33 t/h against 72 t/h truck capacity, stockpile 111 of 450 t). No loans: no stope is down and no repair estimates are open.
